statement: Commercial vessel transit through the Strait of Hormuz is suspended for 48 or more consecutive hours between 2026-08-02 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: YES if at least two major international wire services report suspension of commercial transit through the Strait of Hormuz lasting 48 or more consecutive hours between 2026-08-02 and 2026-10-30; otherwise NO.

statement: US or Israeli forces strike Iranian oil or gas export infrastructure at Kharg Island, Bandar Abbas, or Asaluyeh between 2026-08-02 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: YES if at least two major international news agencies report a US or Israeli strike on Iranian oil or gas export facilities at Kharg Island, Bandar Abbas, or Asaluyeh between 2026-08-02 and 2026-09-30; otherwise NO.

statement: A formally announced ceasefire covering all active front lines in the Russia-Ukraine war takes effect between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: YES if Reuters, AP, or AFP report a ceasefire covering all active front lines of the Russia-Ukraine war formally in effect between 2026-08-02 and 2027-01-15; otherwise NO.

statement: Brent crude front-month futures settle at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-03 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: YES if the ICE Brent front-month settlement price is at or above 100.00 USD on any trading day between 2026-08-03 and 2026-12-31, per exchange data or major financial press; otherwise NO.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield closes at or above 5.00 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-08-03 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: YES if the US Treasury daily par yield curve shows the 10-year rate at or above 5.00 percent for any date between 2026-08-03 and 2026-12-31; otherwise NO.

statement: The US Senate confirms Todd Blanche as Attorney General between 2026-08-02 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: YES if the Senate holds a successful confirmation vote on Todd Blanche for Attorney General between 2026-08-02 and 2026-11-30, per the Congressional Record or two major US outlets; otherwise NO.

statement: Gianni Infantino ceases to hold the FIFA presidency by resignation, removal, or formal suspension between 2026-08-02 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: YES if FIFA or two major international news outlets report that Infantino resigned, was removed, or was formally suspended as FIFA president between 2026-08-02 and 2026-12-18; otherwise NO.

statement: CISA adds an Adobe Campaign Classic vulnerability first disclosed between 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-01 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-08-02 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: YES if the CISA KEV catalog lists an Adobe Campaign Classic entry with dateAdded between 2026-08-02 and 2026-10-30; otherwise NO.

statement: CISA or EPA publicly attributes an operational disruption at a US drinking water or wastewater utility to a cyberattack between 2026-08-02 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: YES if a CISA or EPA advisory, or two major US outlets, report agency attribution of a utility operational disruption to a cyberattack between 2026-08-02 and 2026-12-31; otherwise NO.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 4.5 or greater occurs with epicenter within 30 km of Naples, Italy, between 2026-08-02 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: YES if the USGS or INGV earthquake catalog records an event of magnitude 4.5 or greater with epicenter within 30 km of Naples between 2026-08-02 and 2026-12-31; otherwise NO.
